modes.DORMANT: Relational carrier retained; no activation witness; exact zero physical backreaction.
modes.RELATIONAL_GRAMMAR_ACTIVE: Identity, relation, witness, route, event, branch, conservation, memory, promotion, or reopening active without direct point-body mechanics.
modes.DIRECT_MANY_BODY_ACTIVE: Physical constituents, clocks, geometry/phase space, scales, interactions, constraints, and activation witnesses are present.

solution_growth_rule: Strict solution-capacity growth requires a new witnessed, admissible, non-gauge-equivalent closure.
